messages:
Jordan: Idea: tiny 'Lights & Notes' table for holiday week ":sparkles:" — drop a little handwritten note or postcard and a battery tea-light (LED) by Thurs 2pm. Low effort, high cheer.

Mei: Love this. Can we label the box "open for warm notes"? I need vibes. :candle:

Carlos: Count me in. Ill bring a stash of battery tea-lights and a tiny pack of envelopes.

Anya: Will handwritten be awkward? I barely write with pens anymore. :sweat_smile: E-cards okay?

Jordan: E-cards totally fine. Just something small and friendly. If you bring a physical note, tuck it under the light so it looks cozy.

Priya: Ill add a sticker sheet so people can decorate. Also — can we avoid anything scented? A few folks have sensitivities.

ops-bot: Reminder: Table set in kitchen by Wed 10:00 AM. Please avoid open flame; LED tea-lights only.

Carlos: PSA: if you ship a postcard, please remove bulky packaging and address it to "Office - Lights & Notes" so mail volunteers can sort.

Mei: Photo idea: we can take a low-light collage of the table Fri morning and post for remote smiles. Remote folks can add emoji reactions to vote for "cheeriest note".

Anya: Suggestion: tiny prompts on the sign-up sheet like "One small thing I'm grateful for" or "Tiny silly holiday memory" to help people who get stuck.

Jordan: Good call. I put three prompts on the sheet: gratitude, favorite tiny tradition, silly holiday fail. Link: https://intranet.redwood/lights-and-notes-2025

Priya: Also volunteering for a quick scan for any private info on postcards before posting collage. Dont want anyone's phone number accidentally shared.

Carlos: Dropping items off Thu morning. If anyone wants to coordinate drops after hours, DM me and Ill label.

tinsel-bot: Tiny reminder: Lights & Notes drop-off closes Thu 2:00 PM. Collage post will go up Fri 9:30 AM. Reaction voting closes Fri 5:00 PM.

Mei: Ooh and can we add a tiny prize: a mystery holiday mug? Winner chosen by most reactions. Neutral, small, cheerful.

Jordan: Winner prize confirmed: mug + cocoa packet. No corporate swag, just cozy stuff. :)

Anya: Adding my note now. Prompt used: "one small thing I'm grateful for: weekday walks with headphones". Feels cheesy but true.

Carlos: Photo uploaded when table is set. Also leaving a spare pack of batteries by the box.

Priya: If anyone's remote and wants to send a quick e-note, drop a short message in this thread and Ill print it for the collage.

Jordan: Thanks everyone! Tiny, low-friction, and hopefully a little light in the week. Happy holidays and bring your tiny cards! :sparkling_heart:
